purpose: Check whether a supplied Pennsylvania business address is consistent with the selected Pennsylvania registry entity using official registry and Census geocoding evidence.

decision_policy.match: A unique strong PA registry identity match is available and both addresses Census-match with the same primary street number and ZIP within 0.25 miles.
decision_policy.human_review: Any identity/address evidence is failed, unavailable, uncertain, ambiguous, or contradictory.

claim_boundaries: match means only that the supplied address is consistent with the selected public registry address under the configured Census comparison
it does not prove physical presence or control of the address
it does not establish good standing, ownership, authority to contract, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance
